text: In Husserl's analysis of intentionality, the 'noema' is:
choices: The intentional act of consciousness (perceiving, judging)
The real physical object existing in the world
The object precisely as it is meant or presented to consciousness
The transcendental ego that remains after the reduction
explanation: The noema is the object precisely as it is meant or presented to consciousness (its mode of givenness), paralleling Fregean sense. The noesis is the act itself; the real worldly object is distinct from the noema; and the transcendental ego is the pure subject of experience, not the intended content.
